--DELETE FROM EDS.DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT WHERE TXN_DATE = CAST(@process_date AS DATE);

WITH DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT_MBK
AS
(

	SELECT 
		BANK_ID
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,SUM(TXN_COUNT * GROSS_TXN_FEE) AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME
		,SUM(TXN_COUNT * NET_TXN_FEE) AS NET_FEE_INCOME
		,SOURCE_CODE
		,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			CTRAN.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID,
			--DTE.CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE, 
			EOMONTH(CAST(CTRAN.TXN_DATE AS DATE))  AS TXN_DATE, 
			CTRAN.CIF_NO AS CIF_ID, 
			CTRAN.BILLER_ID, 
			COUNT(CTRAN.TXN_ID) AS TXN_COUNT, 
			CTRAN.[STATUS] AS TXN_STATUS,
			CTRAN.FROM_ACCT_CCY AS CRNCY_CODE,	
			SUM(CTRAN.TXN_AMT) AS TXN_AMT_ORIG, 
			SUM(CTRAN.TXN_AMT_PHP) TXN_AMT_PHP,
			CTRAN.TXN_TYPE, 
			CTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME AS RECEIVING_BANK, 
			COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
			COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) AS NET_TXN_FEE,
			CTRAN.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE
		FROM (
						SELECT 
							CUST.CIF_NO, 
							MBKTRAN.BNK_CODE, 
							MBKTRAN.SOURCE_CODE, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_DATE, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_ID, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_TYPE, 
							MBKTRAN.[STATUS], 
							MBKTRAN.BILLER_ID, 
							MBKTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_AMT, 
							MBKTRAN.TXN_AMT_PHP,
							MBKTRAN.FROM_ACCT_CCY
						FROM 
							(  
									SELECT 
										DISTINCT
										CIF_NO,
										CUST_ID
									FROM 
										EDS.MBK_RTBKCUSTOMERMTB 
									WHERE 
										BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
							) CUST
							INNER JOIN	
							(
									SELECT 
									BNK_CODE,
									SOURCE_CODE,
									TXN_DATE, 
									TXN_ID, 
									TXN_TYPE, 
									[STATUS], 
									CUST_ID, 
									TXN_FIELD1 BILLER_ID, 
									FROM_ACCT_CCY, 
									TO_BANK_NAME, 
									TXN_AMT, 
									CASE WHEN FROM_ACCT_CCY <> 'PHP' THEN TXN_AMT *  ConversionRate ELSE TXN_AMT END  TXN_AMT_PHP
									FROM 
										EDS.MBK_RTBKTRANSACTIONMTB A
									LEFT JOIN 
										(    
											SELECT 
												CONVERT(varchar(12), CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 112) CurrencyConversionTimestamp, ConvertFromCurrencyId, 
												ConversionRate 
											FROM 
												BNKM.CurrencyConversion
											WHERE 
												ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND 
												RateId = 'REV' AND 
												FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01'
										) RATE 
										ON RATE.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = CONVERT(varchar(8), A.TXN_DATE, 112) 
										AND Rate.ConvertFromCurrencyId = A.FROM_ACCT_CCY

									WHERE 
										BNK_CODE = 'CBC01' 
							) MBKTRAN 
							ON CUST.CUST_ID = MBKTRAN.CUST_ID 
			) CTRAN
		INNER JOIN eds.DATE_DIM DTE 
			ON DTE.FULLDATE = CAST(CTRAN.TXN_DATE AS DATE)
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				) DBD1
			ON CTRAN.TXN_TYPE = DBD1.TXN_TYPE
			AND CTRAN.TXN_TYPE NOT IN ('BP', 'BPQ')
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				) DBD2
			ON DBD2.BILLER_ID = CTRAN.BILLER_ID
			AND COALESCE(CTRAN.BILLER_ID,'') <> ''
			AND CTRAN.TXN_TYPE IN ('BP', 'BPQ')	
		GROUP BY 
			CTRAN.BNK_CODE,
			--DTE.CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE, 
			EOMONTH(CAST(CTRAN.TXN_DATE AS DATE)), 
			CTRAN.CIF_NO, 
			CTRAN.BILLER_ID, 
			CTRAN.[STATUS],
			CTRAN.FROM_ACCT_CCY,	
			CTRAN.TXN_TYPE, 
			CTRAN.TO_BANK_NAME, 
			COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE),
			COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE),
			CTRAN.SOURCE_CODE
			
	) TMP_MBK_AGG_TXN
	GROUP BY
		BANK_ID
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,SOURCE_CODE

)

,DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT_RIB
AS
(
    SELECT 
        BANK_ID
        ,TXN_DATE
        ,CIF_ID
        ,BILLER_ID
        ,TXN_COUNT
        ,TXN_STATUS
        ,CRNCY_CODE
        ,TXN_AMT_ORIG
        ,TXN_AMT_PHP
        ,TXN_TYPE
        ,RECEIVING_BANK
        ,GROSS_TXN_FEE
        ,NET_TXN_FEE
        ,(TXN_COUNT * GROSS_TXN_FEE) AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME
        ,(TXN_COUNT * NET_TXN_FEE) AS NET_FEE_INCOME
        ,SOURCE_CODE
        ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
    FROM 
    ( 
        SELECT  
            A.BANK_ID AS BANK_ID,
            --DTE.CURRENT_MONTH_END AS TXN_DATE,
            EOMONTH(CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE))  AS TXN_DATE, 		
            B.CUST_ID AS CIF_ID,
            COALESCE(DBD2.BILLER_ID,DBD3.BILLER_ID,DBD1.BILLER_ID) AS BILLER_ID,
            COUNT(A.TXN_ID) AS TXN_COUNT,
            BB.TXN_ENTRY_STATUS AS TXN_STATUS,
            A.TXN_CRN AS CRNCY_CODE,
            SUM(A.TOTAL_TXN_AMT) AS TXN_AMT_ORIG,
            SUM(A.TOTAL_TXN_AMT_IN_HOMECRN) AS TXN_AMT_PHP,
            A.TXN_TYPE AS TXN_TYPE,
            NULL AS RECEIVING_BANK,
            COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD3.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD3.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
            COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD3.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD3.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) AS NET_TXN_FEE,
            A.SOURCE_CODE AS SOURCE_CODE
        FROM 
            EDS.RIB_TRANSACTIONHEADER A 
        INNER JOIN eds.DATE_DIM DTE 
                ON DTE.FULLDATE = CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE)
        INNER JOIN 
            (
                SELECT 
                    ROW_NUMBER() over(PARTITION by TRIM(CORP_USER), BNK_CODE ORDER BY SCD_START_DATE) RN ,
                    CUST_ID,
                    TRIM(CORP_USER) CORP_USER,
                    DEL_FLG,
                    R_CRE_TIME,
                    SCD_START_DATE,
                    SCD_END_DATE,
                    BNK_CODE 
                FROM 
                    EDS.RIB_CORPORATEUSER
            ) B 
            ON B.BNK_CODE = A.BNK_CODE 
            AND A.CORP_USER = B.CORP_USER 
            AND CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE) BETWEEN (CASE WHEN B.RN = 1 THEN B.R_CRE_TIME ELSE B.SCD_START_DATE END)  AND B.SCD_END_DATE
        LEFT JOIN 
            (   
                SELECT 
                    CONVERT(varchar(12), CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 112) CurrencyConversionTimestamp, 
                    ConvertFromCurrencyId, 
                    ConversionRate 
                FROM 
                    BNKM.CurrencyConversion
                WHERE 
                    ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' 
                    AND RateId = 'REV' 
                    AND FinancialInstitutionId = 'CBC01'
            ) RATE 
            ON RATE.CurrencyConversionTimestamp = CONVERT(varchar(8), A.TXN_DATE, 112) 
            AND Rate.ConvertFromCurrencyId = A.TXN_CRN

        LEFT JOIN eds.RIB_TRANSACTIONDETAILS BB 
            ON BB.TXN_ID = A.TXN_ID 
            AND BB.TXN_ENTRY_STATUS = (CASE WHEN A.TXN_STATUS = 'PRO' THEN 'PEN' ELSE A.TXN_STATUS END) 
            AND BB.BANK_ID = A.BANK_ID
        LEFT JOIN eds.RIB_CUSTOMERPAYEE C 
            ON  CAST(C.PAYEE_LIST_ID as varchar(35)) = BB.CP_ENTITY_ID 
            AND C.BNK_CODE = BB.BNK_CODE
        LEFT JOIN eds.RIB_PAYEEMASTER D 
            ON D.BNF_ID = C.BNF_ID 
            AND D.BNK_CODE = C.BNK_CODE  
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
                    CASE 
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
                    END D_FEE
                    ,
                    *
                    FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
                ) DBD1
            ON A.TXN_TYPE = DBD1.TXN_TYPE
            AND A.TXN_TYPE NOT IN ('BPR', 'QPT')

            
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
                    CASE 
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
                    END D_FEE
                    ,
                    *
                    FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
                ) DBD2
            ON  BB.CP_ENTITY_EXTN1 = DBD2.BILLER_NAME
            AND A.TXN_TYPE IN ('BPR', 'QPT')	
            AND COALESCE(BB.CP_ENTITY_EXTN1,'') <> ''
            
            
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
                    CASE 
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
                    WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
                    END D_FEE
                    ,
                    *
                    FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
                ) DBD3
            ON  D.BNF_NAME = DBD3.BILLER_NAME
            AND A.TXN_TYPE IN ('BPR', 'QPT') 
            AND COALESCE(BB.CP_ENTITY_EXTN1,'') = ''
            
            
            
        WHERE 
            A.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01' 
            AND  LEFT(B.CUST_ID,1) = 'R' 
            AND A.DEL_FLG = 'N' 
            AND B.DEL_FLG = 'N'
        GROUP BY 
            A.BANK_ID,
            --DTE.CURRENT_MONTH_END, 
            EOMONTH(CAST(A.TXN_DATE AS DATE)),
            B.CUST_ID,
            COALESCE(DBD2.BILLER_ID,DBD3.BILLER_ID,DBD1.BILLER_ID),
            BB.TXN_ENTRY_STATUS,
            A.TXN_CRN,
            A.TXN_TYPE,
            COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD3.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD3.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE),
            COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD3.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD3.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE),
            A.SOURCE_CODE
        
    ) TMP_RIB_AGG_TXN	
)

,DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT_D30
AS
(
	SELECT 
		 BANK_ID
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,SUM(TXN_COUNT * GROSS_TXN_FEE) AS GROSS_FEE_INCOME
		,SUM(TXN_COUNT * NET_TXN_FEE) AS NET_FEE_INCOME
		,SOURCE_CODE,
		CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
	FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			'CBC01' AS BANK_ID,
			EOMONTH(CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END)  AS TXN_DATE, 
			B.CIF_ID AS CIF_ID, 
			A.[Biller Mnemonic] AS BILLER_ID, 
			COUNT(*) AS TXN_COUNT, 
			A.[Status] AS TXN_STATUS,
			A.[Transaction Currency] AS CRNCY_CODE,	
			SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.[TRANSACTION AMOUNT],',',''),'.','') AS NUMERIC(11,2))) AS TXN_AMT_ORIG, 
			SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(A.[TRANSACTION AMOUNT],',',''),'.','') AS NUMERIC(11,2))) AS TXN_AMT_PHP,
			A.[Transaction Type] AS TXN_TYPE, 
			A.[Transferee Bank] AS RECEIVING_BANK, 
			COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) AS GROSS_TXN_FEE,
			COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE) AS NET_TXN_FEE,
			'D30' AS SOURCE_CODE
		FROM 
			eds.d30_TransactionReport A
		INNER JOIN 
			eds.d30_Customer B 
			ON B.USERNAME = A.UserName
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD1
			ON A.[Transaction Type] = DBD1.TXN_TYPE 
			AND A.[Transaction Type] NOT IN ('BillPay')	
		LEFT JOIN (SELECT 
					CASE 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN EBK_BP 
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NOT NULL THEN P2B_BP
					WHEN PROPRIETARY_TAG IS NULL AND P2B_TAG IS NULL THEN DEFAULT_FEE_BP
					END D_FEE
					,
					*
					FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM 
				  ) DBD2
			ON A.[Biller Mnemonic] = DBD2.BILLER_ID 
			AND A.[Transaction Type] IN ('BillPay')
		WHERE 
			[Transaction Category] = 'Financial'
			AND ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1
		GROUP BY 
			EOMONTH(CASE WHEN ISDATE(A.[Transaction Date])=1 THEN CAST(A.[Transaction Date] AS DATE) END) ,
			B.CIF_ID, 
			A.[Biller Mnemonic], 
			A.[Status],
			A.[Transaction Currency],	
			A.[Transaction Type], 
			A.[Transferee Bank],
			COALESCE(DBD2.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD1.GROSS_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE),
			COALESCE(DBD2.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD1.NET_TXN_FEE,DBD2.D_FEE,DBD1.D_FEE)
	) TMP_D30_AGG_TXN
	GROUP BY
		 BANK_ID
		,TXN_DATE
		,CIF_ID
		,BILLER_ID
		,TXN_COUNT
		,TXN_STATUS
		,CRNCY_CODE
		,TXN_AMT_ORIG
		,TXN_AMT_PHP
		,TXN_TYPE
		,RECEIVING_BANK
		,GROSS_TXN_FEE
		,NET_TXN_FEE
		,SOURCE_CODE
)

INSERT INTO EDS.DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT
(
	 BANK_ID
	,TXN_DATE
	,CIF_ID
	,BILLER_ID
	,TXN_COUNT
	,TXN_STATUS
	,CRNCY_CODE
	,TXN_AMT_ORIG
	,TXN_AMT_PHP
	,TXN_TYPE
	,RECEIVING_BANK
	,GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,NET_TXN_FEE
	,GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,NET_FEE_INCOME
	,SOURCE_CODE
	,INSERT_DTTM
)
SELECT 
	CAST(BANK_ID AS varchar(8)) BANK_ID
	,CAST(TXN_DATE AS date) TXN_DATE
	,CAST(CIF_ID AS varchar(20)) CIF_ID
	,CAST(BILLER_ID AS varchar(120)) BILLER_ID
	,CAST(TXN_COUNT AS bigint) TXN_COUNT
	,CAST(TXN_STATUS AS varchar(40)) TXN_STATUS
	,CAST(CRNCY_CODE AS varchar(3)) CRNCY_CODE
	,CAST(TXN_AMT_ORIG AS numeric(15,5)) TXN_AMT_ORIG
	,CAST(TXN_AMT_PHP AS numeric(15,5)) TXN_AMT_PHP
	,CAST(TXN_TYPE AS varchar(120)) TXN_TYPE
	,CAST(RECEIVING_BANK AS varchar(100)) RECEIVING_BANK
	,CAST(GROSS_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(NET_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) NET_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(GROSS_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(NET_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) NET_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(SOURCE_CODE AS varchar(20)) SOURCE_CODE
	,CAST(INSERT_DTTM AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM
FROM DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT_MBK
 
UNION ALL
 
SELECT 
	CAST(BANK_ID AS varchar(8)) BANK_ID
	,CAST(TXN_DATE AS date) TXN_DATE
	,CAST(CIF_ID AS varchar(20)) CIF_ID
	,CAST(BILLER_ID AS varchar(120)) BILLER_ID
	,CAST(TXN_COUNT AS bigint) TXN_COUNT
	,CAST(TXN_STATUS AS varchar(40)) TXN_STATUS
	,CAST(CRNCY_CODE AS varchar(3)) CRNCY_CODE
	,CAST(TXN_AMT_ORIG AS numeric(15,5)) TXN_AMT_ORIG
	,CAST(TXN_AMT_PHP AS numeric(15,5)) TXN_AMT_PHP
	,CAST(TXN_TYPE AS varchar(120)) TXN_TYPE
	,CAST(RECEIVING_BANK AS varchar(100)) RECEIVING_BANK
	,CAST(GROSS_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(NET_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) NET_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(GROSS_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(NET_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) NET_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(SOURCE_CODE AS varchar(20)) SOURCE_CODE
	,CAST(INSERT_DTTM AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM
FROM DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT_RIB
 
UNION ALL
 
SELECT 
	CAST(BANK_ID AS varchar(8)) BANK_ID
	,CAST(TXN_DATE AS date) TXN_DATE
	,CAST(CIF_ID AS varchar(20)) CIF_ID
	,CAST(BILLER_ID AS varchar(120)) BILLER_ID
	,CAST(TXN_COUNT AS bigint) TXN_COUNT
	,CAST(TXN_STATUS AS varchar(40)) TXN_STATUS
	,CAST(CRNCY_CODE AS varchar(3)) CRNCY_CODE
	,CAST(TXN_AMT_ORIG AS numeric(15,5)) TXN_AMT_ORIG
	,CAST(TXN_AMT_PHP AS numeric(15,5)) TXN_AMT_PHP
	,CAST(TXN_TYPE AS varchar(120)) TXN_TYPE
	,CAST(RECEIVING_BANK AS varchar(100)) RECEIVING_BANK
	,CAST(GROSS_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) GROSS_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(NET_TXN_FEE AS numeric(5,2)) NET_TXN_FEE
	,CAST(GROSS_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) GROSS_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(NET_FEE_INCOME AS numeric(15,5)) NET_FEE_INCOME
	,CAST(SOURCE_CODE AS varchar(20)) SOURCE_CODE
	,CAST(INSERT_DTTM AS datetime) INSERT_DTTM
FROM DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT_D30
